Empty default skips the assignment. Emitted assignment sets principalType=ServicePrincipal. See notes/task-030-deviations.md N1: `Cognitive Services User` is scoped to Microsoft.CognitiveServices resource provider and is functionally dormant on this Microsoft.Search resource; the AI Search data-plane MI grant that IS actionable (`Search Index Data Contributor` / `Search Service Contributor`) is deferred to a follow-on task.
